title: ControlPressureVector
description: Continuous, BOUNDED pressure over control dimensions — NOT direct commands. This output MUST NOT directly override the host agent (9to5). It is pressure only: a modulator, never a replacement. Each component is a signed pressure in [-1, 1] (negative = ease off, positive = push harder), applied within the authority caps. Output contract v0.1.

authority_tier.description: Effective tier that gates how much of this pressure is actually applied (min over 5 caps).

pressures.description: Signed bounded pressures. Positive pushes toward more of the named dimension; negative eases off. All in [-1, 1].

effort.description: Compute/effort allocation (bidirectional; may raise OR lower).

verification.description: Verification depth. ADDITIVE ONLY — may deepen, never reduces below the verifier's own requirement.

society_debate.description: Pressure to spawn a heterogeneous critic / debate.

sources.description: Provenance: which signals produced this pressure (instinct signal ids, drive pressures, dissonance).

causal_trace_id.description: Ref to the CausalTrace that produced this vector (receipts).
